description: This file defines the WidgetPreviewActivity class, an Android Activity responsible for managing widget selection, configuration, preview rendering, snapshot capturing, and sharing functionalities within a widget preview application.

classes.name: WidgetPreviewActivity
classes.description: Main activity class that handles widget selection, preview setup, snapshot creation, and sharing.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and manages widget binding or selection.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Starts listening to widget host updates.

methods.name: onRetainNonConfigurationInstance
methods.description: Retains widget info across configuration changes.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from widget pick and configuration activities.

methods.name: setAppWidget
methods.description: Sets up the selected widget, including binding and configuration.

methods.name: finishSetAppWidget
methods.description: Completes widget setup by creating and displaying widget view.

methods.name: getLauncherCellDimensions
methods.description: Calculates appropriate preview dimensions based on widget size and device resources.

methods.name: buildFile
methods.description: Constructs the File object for saving or sharing widget snapshot images.

methods.name: getPreviewBitmap
methods.description: Captures a Bitmap snapshot of the widget view.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves the captured Bitmap to external storage as a PNG file.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Handles back button press to initiate widget selection activity.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles snapshot saving and email sharing button clicks.
